unlock: Cuts Day 1 tractor input lag when slotted into the dish (bible: 25 %).
_source: Real cobalt blue tarantula (Cyriopagopus lividus, formerly Haplopelma lividum) care, read 2026-11-25. Temperature: The Tarantula Collective 20-26 C (https://www.thetarantulacollective.com/caresheets/cyriopagopus-lividus); Exotics Source 75-82 F = 23.9-27.8 C (https://exoticssource.com/blogs/exotic-topics/cobalt-blue-tarantula-cyriopagopus-lividum-complete-care-guide); The Defiant Forest 74-82 F = 23.3-27.8 C (https://www.thedefiantforest.com/blogs/news/cobalt-blue-tarantula-care-guide-cobalt-blue-tarantulas-cyriopagopus-lividus-size-origin-temperament-and-care). Bantam Earth 25-30 C (https://bantam.earth/cobalt-blue-tarantula-cyriopagopus-lividus/). All four overlap at 25-26 C, and ideal_temp_c is 25, the low end of that overlap, which is also the midpoint of the 24-26 C three-source overlap. Humidity: Exotics Source 75-85 % and The Tarantula Collective 75-85 % (its breeding section; its general care text gives no number); The Defiant Forest 70-80 %. ideal_humidity_pct is the midpoint of 75-85, 80 (unchanged). The tolerances (+-3 C, +-8 %) and lag_reduction_pct (25) are still the art bible's, not from these sources, and are [PLACEHOLDER]. Molt: only Bantam Earth gives an interval, one to seven months (molt_interval_real_days_range, real-world days: 30-210, https://bantam.earth/cobalt-blue-tarantula-cyriopagopus-lividus/), and says it lengthens with age; no source gives days by life stage or a premolt length. molt_days (the game's tank molt) and premolt_days stay unset [PLACEHOLDER]; the tank still molts on the playtest pace.
